title: Pinned visualization strategy and reproducible workspace
intent: Preserve agreed roles, rationale, implementation truth, source paths, and resumption controls; no silent changes or imagined integrations.

ordered_pipeline.observed_implementation: Custom HTML5 Canvas node-link graph in site/assets/app.js
ordered_pipeline.why: Exploratory entity neighborhoods, typed links, filterable clusters
ordered_pipeline.upgrade_gate: Introduce Cytoscape as a projection renderer over existing graph JSON; prove stable IDs, filtering, selection and provenance before marking installed.

ordered_pipeline.observed_implementation: HTML/CSS architecture boxes and JavaScript project routing cards
ordered_pipeline.why: Explicit Project → Profile → Fact class → Owner module → Repository/entrypoint
ordered_pipeline.upgrade_gate: Implement separately from the semantic graph with exact authority route consistency; preserve NOT_ASSERTED_BY_A7 for project artifacts.

ordered_pipeline.observed_implementation: JavaScript-driven Project × Module and authority HTML tables
ordered_pipeline.why: Precise IDs, relationship verification, joins, exceptions and evidence
ordered_pipeline.upgrade_gate: Keep audit tables usable even when graph interfaces are upgraded.

ordered_pipeline.observed_implementation: Python produces a7-architecture.mmd; site shows copyable source, not Mermaid rendering
ordered_pipeline.why: Versionable reproducible diagrams and readable Git diffs
ordered_pipeline.upgrade_gate: Optional renderer must read the generated Mermaid source without changing truth.

ordered_pipeline.observed_implementation: Python produces a7-excalidraw.json; no embedded Excalidraw editor/plugin
ordered_pipeline.why: Editable explanatory canvases and human review annotations
ordered_pipeline.upgrade_gate: Store annotations separately; never back-write canonical facts from user sketches.

ordered_pipeline.observed_implementation: HTML5 Canvas projection from generated XYZ using manual perspective; no Three.js/WebGL
ordered_pipeline.why: Optional spatial relationship exploration at large scale
ordered_pipeline.upgrade_gate: Only use WebGL when performance/accessibility justifies it, and preserve 2D/table alternatives.

shared_data_model: One canonical A7 JSON/JSONL and owning provider source; Python generates graph, search, route/authority matrices, Mermaid, Excalidraw, XYZ and SHA-256 lineage; website is read-only projection.
read_first: Fetch LIVE A7_BOOTSTRAP.json, this decision, source code and latest CI/Pages deployment before any claims or edits.
Never mistake desired Cytoscape/React Flow libraries for installed code; validate actual imports/dependencies.
Never mistake Mermaid .mmd or Excalidraw JSON exports for integrated rendering/editing plugins.
3D presently uses manual Canvas perspective, not WebGL/Three.js.
A project/module route means routable, NOT existence of project-specific specialist artifacts.
No generated graph, table, canvas, site, or annotation becomes source of authority.
For a change, preserve PRE → feature/CI → PR/main → provider readback → POST and append events.
Never silently replace six roles; log explicit rationale and obtain human acceptance for material changes.
